name: run_session_command
description:
Run a command (an executable plus args) inside a running sandbox session, with optional cwd, environment variables, sudo, and timeout. By default it returns immediately with a command ID; set wait to true to wait for the command to finish. Use get_session_command and get_session_command_logs to check status and read output.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command. Each argument should be a separate array element.

command.description: The executable or shell command to run. This is the program name without arguments.

cwd.description: The working directory in which to execute the command. Defaults to the sandbox home directory if not specified.

env.description: Additional environment variables to set for this command. These are merged with the sandbox environment.

logs.description: If true, stream the logs of the command execution in real-time via ND-JSON. This is only applicable if `wait` is also true.

sudo.description: Execute the command with root (superuser) privileges.

timeout.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds the command may run before it is killed with SIGKILL, up to 5 hours. Enforced at exec time, independently of `wait`.

wait.description: If true, returns an ND-JSON stream that emits the command status when started and again when finished. Useful for synchronously waiting for command completion.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session in which to execute the command.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
